items.note: Title rules (Airbnb): capitalize only the first word plus proper names and abbreviations (neighbourhood, landmark, airport code); no emojis; single special characters are fine but not repeated for emphasis (!!!, ***); separate ideas with commas or a single slash; Content Policy bars misleading info and symbols/emojis in titles. Description: lead with what matters, don't repeat the amenities list, be specific ('a perfect base for exploring the city'), be upfront about challenges (stairs, children, mobility). The 500-character description cap and 32-character visible-title figure circulate on third-party sites only (e.g. Guesty help) and are not recorded.

items.note: The Stores spec page publishes no character caps for tiles (the builder enforces its own). Text tiles hold freeform text that can link to a Store page or detail page; 'Image with text' tiles carry a prefix, heading, body and link text (text over image) or a header and description (text next to image). Amazon discourages text baked into images ('The text will not be readable by search engines, or by people who rely on screen readers') - use the Image with text tile. Some text fields are not supported in the custom mobile layout and show on desktop only. The same mobile guide recommends a minimum 90 pt Arial-equivalent font for header copy.

items.note: Headline rules from the moderation guide: sentence case only ('only capitalize the first word in a headline, sentence, any proper nouns, or trademarks'; Title Case, ALL CAPS, toggle and mixed case are rejected); no numerals, *, @ or periods in place of letters or to shorten words (H8, w/out) unless part of a brand or slogan or symbols like $ and #; claims in the headline need proof and must match the product detail page; 'Optimized ads must contain general headlines that don't mention specific products'; ads must be in the primary language of the site. Amazon's public pages read on 2026-10-05 do NOT state the Sponsored Brands headline character cap: the 50-character figure widely quoted for it is printed officially only for Amazon DSP display creatives (see plat:amazon_dsp_display), and the console shows the live counter. Collections ads need 3 or more products; Store spotlight needs a Store with at least 4 pages.
